title: montia fontana var. minor
intro: Montia fontana var. minor, commonly known as Lesser Pondweed, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Montiaceae. It is a perennial herb native to wetlands and aquatic environments in Europe and North America, characterized by its small, green leaves and white or pink flowers. The health benefits of Lesser Pondweed include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory effects.
